import lexer = "./lexer.qui" import ini = "./ini_parser.qui" import interpolate = "./interpolate.qui" class Output(interpolate.Definition definition, string kind, bool secret, string notation, int measure, bool truth, bool fixed, string limit) class DiffEntry(string sign, string key, string before, string after) class Diff(string first, string second) nat added := 0 nat removed := 0 nat changed := 0 DiffEntry[] entries := [] string string_notation(string text) string result := DQ for: index < #text character := text[index] if character == "\" result += "\\" elif character == DQ result += "\" + DQ elif character == NL result += "\n" elif character == HT result += "\t" else result += character return result + DQ string shown(Output output) return if output.secret then "********" else output.notation string scalar_notation(string kind, string text, number := 0, truth := false) if kind == "string" return string_notation(text) if kind == "bool" return if truth then "true" else "false" if kind == "int" or kind == "size" or kind == "duration" return string(number) return text string list_notation(string[] items) return "[" + items.join(", ") + "]" string[] normalized_block

(const P profile) string[] lines := ["profile " + profile.name] previous := "" for key := ini.ordered_keys(profile.outputs.keys())[] section := ini.section_of(key) if section != previous lines = lines.append("[" + section + "]") previous = section Output output := lexer.entry(profile.outputs, key) lines = lines.append(ini.key_name(key) + " = " + shown(output)) return lines string[] diagnostics_block

(const P profile) lines := ["profile {profile.name} errors {profile.errors} warnings {profile.warnings}"] for diagnostic := profile.diagnostics[] lines = lines.append(diagnostic.origin.text() + " " + diagnostic.code + " " + diagnostic.message) return lines string[] report_block

(const P profile) string[] lines := ["profile " + profile.name, "includes"] for (depth, document) := profile.tree[] lines = lines.append(" " * (2 + 2 * depth) + document) lines = lines.append("overridden") if #profile.overridden == 0 lines = lines.append(" (none)") for (key, history) := profile.overridden[] string[] origins := [] for origin := history[] origins = origins.append(origin.text()) lines = lines.append(" " + key + ": " + origins.join(" -> ")) lines = lines.append("keys {profile.outputs.size()} documents {profile.document_keys} manifest {profile.manifest_keys} defaults {profile.default_keys}") lines = lines.append("dropped {profile.dropped}") lines = lines.append("errors {profile.errors} warnings {profile.warnings}") return lines string[] diff_block(Diff difference) lines := ["diff {difference.first} -> {difference.second}: {difference.added} added, {difference.removed} removed, {difference.changed} changed"] for change := difference.entries[] if change.sign == "+" lines = lines.append("+ {change.key} = {change.after}") elif change.sign == "-" lines = lines.append("- {change.key} = {change.before}") else lines = lines.append("~ {change.key}: {change.before} -> {change.after}") return lines void write_outputs

(const P[] profiles, Diff[] differences) string[] normalized := [] string[] diagnostics := [] string[] reports := [] string[] diffs := [] for profile := profiles[] normalized = normalized.append(normalized_block(profile).join(NL)) diagnostics = diagnostics.append(diagnostics_block(profile).join(NL)) reports = reports.append(report_block(profile).join(NL)) for difference := differences[] diffs = diffs.append(diff_block(difference).join(NL)) bool exists := file.exists("output") if not exists file.mkdir("output") writer1 := file.write("output/normalized.txt") .writer1(normalized.join(NL + NL) + NL) writer2 := file.write("output/diagnostics.txt") .writer2(diagnostics.join(NL + NL) + NL) writer3 := file.write("output/report.txt") .writer3(reports.join(NL + NL) + NL) writer4 := file.write("output/diff.txt") .writer4(diffs.join(NL + NL) + NL)

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"

bool valid_name(string text)
    if text == "" or not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(text[0])
        return false
    for: position < #text
        if not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_".contains(text[position])
            return false
    return true

bool valid_section(string text)
    for part := text.split(".")[]
        if not valid_name(part)
            return false
    return true

string section_of(string key)
    parts := key.split(".")
    return parts[0:<#parts - 1].join(".")

string key_name(string key)
    parts := key.split(".")
    return parts[-1]

string[] ordered_keys(string[] keys)
    string[] sortable := []
    for key := keys[]
        sortable = sortable.append(section_of(key) + NL + key_name(key))
    string[] result := []
    for encoded := sortable.sorted()[]
        result = result.append(encoded.split(NL).join("."))
    return result

string[] trimmed(string[] segments)
    result := segments
    result[0] = lexer.left_trim(result[0])
    result[-1] = lexer.right_trim(result[-1])
    return result

class Statement(string kind, nat line, string target, value := "")

class Document(string name)
    Statement[] statements := []
    lexer.Diagnostic[] diagnostics := []

class Parser(local string document_name)
    document := Document(document_name)
    current_section := ""
    base_section := ""
    assigned := map<string, nat>()

    void .report(nat number, string code, string message)
        document.diagnostics = document.diagnostics.append(
            lexer.Diagnostic(lexer.Origin(document.name, number), code, message))

    void .add(string kind, nat number, string target, value := "")
        document.statements = document.statements.append(Statement(kind, number, target, value))

    void .bad_header(nat number, string message)
        .report(number, "E_SECTION", message)
        current_section = ""

    void .header(nat number, string[] segments)
        text := segments[0]
        if #segments != 1 or not text.ends_with("]")
            .bad_header(number, "invalid section header")
            return
        inside := text[1:<#text - 1]
        child := inside
        parent := ""
        has_parent := false
        match inside.find(":")
            nat colon
                child = inside[0:<colon]
                parent = lexer.trim_spaces(inside[colon + 1:<#inside])
                has_parent = true
            none
                child = inside
        child = lexer.trim_spaces(child)
        relative := child.starts_with(".")
        checked := if relative then child[1:<#child] else child
        if not valid_section(checked) or (has_parent and not valid_section(parent))
            .bad_header(number, "invalid section header")
        elif relative and base_section == ""
            .bad_header(number, "relative section without base")
        else
            if relative
                current_section = base_section + child
            else
                current_section = child
                base_section = child
            if has_parent
                .add("inherit", number, current_section, parent)

    void .directive(nat number, string[] segments)
        string[] words := []
        for word := segments[0].split(" ")[]
            if word != ""
                words = words.append(word)
        if #segments != 1 or #words != 2
            .report(number, "E_SYNTAX", "invalid directive")
        elif (words[0] != "@include" and words[0] != "@unset") or not valid_name(words[1])
            .report(number, "E_SYNTAX", "invalid directive")
        elif words[0] == "@include"
            .add("include", number, words[1])
        elif current_section == ""
            .report(number, "E_NO_SECTION", "no current section")
        else
            .add("unset", number, current_section + "." + words[1])

    void .assignment(nat number, string[] segments)
        equals_outside := false
        for: index < #segments step 2
            if segments[index].contains("=")
                equals_outside = true
        if not equals_outside
            .report(number, "E_SYNTAX", "invalid line")
            return
        match segments[0].find("=")
            nat equal_position
                key := lexer.trim_spaces(segments[0][0:<equal_position])
                append := key.ends_with("+")
                if append
                    key = lexer.right_trim(key[0:<#key - 1])
                if not valid_name(key)
                    .report(number, "E_SYNTAX", "invalid key")
                    return
                value_parts := segments
                value_parts[0] = segments[0][equal_position + 1:<#segments[0]]
                value_parts = trimmed(value_parts)
                value := ""
                if #value_parts == 1
                    value = value_parts[0]
                elif #value_parts == 3 and value_parts[0] == "" and value_parts[2] == ""
                    value = value_parts[1]
                else
                    .report(number, "E_SYNTAX", "invalid value")
                    return
                if current_section == ""
                    .report(number, "E_NO_SECTION", "no current section")
                    return
                full_key := current_section + "." + key
                if not append
                    match assigned.get(full_key)
                        nat earlier
                            .report(number, "W_DUPLICATE", "{full_key} already set at line {earlier}")
                        none
                            equals_outside = true
                    .assigned.set(full_key, number)
                .add(if append then "append" else "assign", number, full_key, value)
            none
                .report(number, "E_SYNTAX", "invalid key")

    void .interpret(lexer.LogicalLine logical)
        if logical.code != ""
            .report(logical.number, logical.code, logical.message)
            return
        parts := trimmed(logical.segments)
        if #parts == 1 and parts[0] == ""
            return
        if parts[0].starts_with("[")
            .header(logical.number, parts)
        elif parts[0].starts_with("@")
            .directive(logical.number, parts)
        else
            .assignment(logical.number, parts)

Document parse_document(string name, string[] physical)
    parser := Parser(name)
    for logical := lexer.logical_lines(physical)[]
        .parser.interpret(logical)
    return parser.document

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import ini = "./ini_parser.qui"

class Definition(string value, lexer.Origin origin, nat number, lexer.Origin[] history)

class Expander(map<string, Definition> definitions)
    results := map<string, string>()
    failed := distinct<string>()
    cycle_keys := distinct<string>()
    string[] in_progress := []
    lexer.Diagnostic[] diagnostics := []

    void .report(lexer.Origin origin, string code, string message)
        diagnostics = diagnostics.append(lexer.Diagnostic(origin, code, message))

    string | none .expand(string key)
        match results.get(key)
            string existing
                return existing
            none
                if failed.has(key)
                    return none
        in_progress = in_progress.append(key)
        string | none expanded := .evaluate(key)
        in_progress = in_progress[0:<#in_progress - 1]
        match expanded
            string value
                .results.set(key, value)
            none
                .failed.add(key)
        return expanded

    string | none .evaluate(string key)
        Definition definition := lexer.entry(definitions, key)
        value := definition.value
        result := ""
        nat position := 0
        while position < #value
            if value[position] != "$" or position + 1 == #value or value[position + 1] != "{{"
                result += if value[position] == VT then "$" else value[position]
                position += 1
                continue
            closing := #value
            match value[position + 2:<#value].find("}}")
                nat offset
                    closing = position + 2 + offset
                none
                    .report(definition.origin, "E_BAD_REF", "{key}: invalid reference")
                    return none
            reference := value[position + 2:<closing]
            if not ini.valid_section(reference)
                .report(definition.origin, "E_BAD_REF", "{key}: invalid reference")
                return none
            target := if reference.contains(".") then reference else ini.section_of(key) + "." + reference
            if not definitions.has(target)
                .report(definition.origin, "E_UNDEFINED", "{key}: undefined reference {target}")
                return none
            string | none replacement := none
            cycle := false
            for: active := in_progress[active_index]
                if active == target
                    path := in_progress[active_index:<#in_progress].append(target)
                    Definition target_definition := lexer.entry(definitions, target)
                    .report(target_definition.origin, "E_CYCLE", "interpolation cycle " + path.join(" -> "))
                    for cycle_key := path[]
                        .cycle_keys.add(cycle_key)
                    cycle = true
                    break
            if not cycle
                replacement = .expand(target)
            match replacement
                string text
                    result += text
                none
                    if not cycle_keys.has(key)
                        .report(definition.origin, "E_DEPENDENCY", "{key}: depends on failed key {target}")
                    return none
            position = closing + 1
        return result

class Origin(string document, nat line)
    string text()
        return "{document}:{line}"

class Diagnostic(Origin origin, string code, string message)

class LogicalLine(nat number)
    string[] segments := []
    code := ""
    message := ""

    void .fail(string failure_code, string failure_message)
        if code == ""
            code = failure_code
            message = failure_message

string left_trim(string text)
    nat first := 0
    while first < #text and text[first] == " "
        first += 1
    return text[first:<#text]

string right_trim(string text)
    last := #text
    while last > 0 and text[last - 1] == " "
        last -= 1
    return text[0:<last]

string trim_spaces(string text)
    return right_trim(left_trim(text))

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    physical := content.split(NL)
    return physical[0:<#physical - 1]

bool before(string left, string right)
    left_codes := left.codepoints()
    right_codes := right.codepoints()
    for: index < #left_codes
        if index == #right_codes
            return false
        if left_codes[index] != right_codes[index]
            return left_codes[index] < right_codes[index]
    return #left_codes < #right_codes

T | error entry<T>(const map<string, T> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        T found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing internal key: {key}")

LogicalLine[] logical_lines(string[] physical)
    LogicalLine[] result := []
    nat physical_index := 0
    while physical_index < #physical
        logical := LogicalLine(physical_index + 1)
        source := physical[physical_index]
        physical_index += 1
        nat position := 0
        quoted := false
        current := ""
        while position < #source
            character := source[position]
            if character == "\" and position + 1 == #source
                source = left_trim(physical[physical_index])
                physical_index += 1
                position = 0
            elif quoted and character == "\"
                follower := source[position + 1]
                if follower == "\" or follower == DQ
                    current += follower
                elif follower == "n"
                    current += NL
                elif follower == "t"
                    current += HT
                elif follower == "$"
                    current += VT
                else
                    .logical.fail("E_ESCAPE", "invalid escape sequence \" + follower)
                position += 2
            elif character == DQ
                logical.segments = logical.segments.append(current)
                current = ""
                quoted = not quoted
                position += 1
            elif not quoted and (character == ";" or character == "#")
                break
            else
                current += character
                position += 1
        if quoted
            .logical.fail("E_UNTERMINATED", "unterminated string")
        logical.segments = logical.segments.append(current)
        result = result.append(logical)
    return result

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import ini = "./ini_parser.qui"
import schema = "./schema.qui"
import interpolate = "./interpolate.qui"
import emitter = "./emitter.qui"

class Scalar(string notation, measure := 0, truth := false)

string lowercase(string text)
    result := ""
    for: index < #text
        character := text[index]
        match "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".find(character)
            nat offset
                result += "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[offset]
            none
                result += character
    return result

bool characters_in(string text, string allowed)
    for: index < #text
        if not allowed.contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

bool digits(string text, nat minimum, nat maximum)
    return minimum <= #text <= maximum and characters_in(text, "0123456789")

int | none integer_value(string text)
    body := text
    negative := body.starts_with("-")
    if negative or body.starts_with("+")
        body = body[1:<#body]
    result := 0
    if body.starts_with("0x") or body.starts_with("0X")
        hexadecimal := lowercase(body[2:<#body])
        if not (1 <= #hexadecimal <= 10) or not characters_in(hexadecimal, "0123456789abcdef")
            return none
        for: index < #hexadecimal
            match "0123456789abcdef".find(hexadecimal[index])
                nat digit
                    result = result * 16 + int(digit)
                none
                    return none
    else
        decimal := ""
        for: index < #body
            character := body[index]
            if character == "_"
                if index == 0 or index + 1 == #body
                    return none
                if not digits(body[index - 1], 1, 1) or not digits(body[index + 1], 1, 1)
                    return none
            elif digits(character, 1, 1)
                decimal += character
            else
                return none
        if not digits(decimal, 1, 12)
            return none
        result = int(decimal)
    return if negative then -result else result

int | none size_value(string text)
    nat position := 0
    while position < #text and digits(text[position], 1, 1)
        position += 1
    whole := text[0:<position]
    if not digits(whole, 1, 6)
        return none
    fraction := ""
    if position < #text and text[position] == "."
        position += 1
        start := position
        while position < #text and digits(text[position], 1, 1)
            position += 1
        fraction = text[start:<position]
        if not digits(fraction, 1, 3)
            return none
    unit := lowercase(text[position:<#text])
    factor := 1
    if unit == "kb"
        factor = 1024
    elif unit == "mb"
        factor = 1048576
    elif unit == "gb"
        factor = 1073741824
    elif unit != "" and unit != "b"
        return none
    int result := int(whole) * factor
    if fraction != ""
        divisor := 1
        for _ < #fraction
            divisor *= 10
        int scaled := int(fraction) * factor
        if scaled % divisor != 0
            return none
        result += scaled / divisor
    return result

int | none duration_value(string text)
    if digits(text, 1, 6)
        return int(text)
    if text == ""
        return none
    nat position := 0
    previous := -1
    result := 0
    factors := [3600, 60, 1]
    while position < #text
        start := position
        while position < #text and digits(text[position], 1, 1)
            position += 1
        number := text[start:<position]
        if not digits(number, 1, 6) or position == #text
            return none
        match "hms".find(text[position])
            nat order
                if int(order) <= previous
                    return none
                previous = int(order)
                result += int(number) * factors[order]
            none
                return none
        position += 1
    return result

string | none host_value(string text)
    if characters_in(text, "0123456789.")
        parts := text.split(".")
        if #parts != 4
            return none
        for part := parts[]
            if not digits(part, 1, 3) or (#part > 1 and part.starts_with("0"))
                return none
            number := int(part)
            if number > 255
                return none
        return text
    if #text > 253
        return none
    for label := text.split(".")[]
        if not (1 <= #label <= 63) or label.starts_with("-") or label.ends_with("-")
            return none
        if not characters_in(lowercase(label), "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-")
            return none
    return lowercase(text)

string | none path_value(string text)
    if text == "" or text.contains(" ") or text.contains(NL) or text.contains(HT)
        return none
    absolute := text.starts_with("/")
    string[] parts := []
    for part := text.split("/")[]
        if part == "" or part == "."
            continue
        if part != ".."
            parts = parts.append(part)
        elif #parts > 0 and parts[-1] != ".."
            parts = parts[0:<#parts - 1]
        elif absolute
            return none
        else
            parts = parts.append(part)
    if absolute
        return "/" + parts.join("/")
    return if #parts == 0 then "." else parts.join("/")

string | none url_value(string text)
    nat boundary := 0
    match text.find("://")
        nat separator
            boundary = separator
        none
            return none
    scheme := lowercase(text[0:<boundary])
    if scheme == "" or not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(scheme[0])
        return none
    if not characters_in(scheme, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+-.")
        return none
    rest := text[boundary + 3:<#text]
    if rest.contains("?") or rest.contains("#")
        return none
    authority := rest
    path := "/"
    match rest.find("/")
        nat slash
            authority = rest[0:<slash]
            path = rest[slash:<#rest]
        none
            authority = rest
    host := authority
    port := ""
    has_port := false
    match authority.find(":")
        nat colon
            host = authority[0:<colon]
            port = authority[colon + 1:<#authority]
            has_port = true
        none
            host = authority
    normalized_host := ""
    normalized_path := ""
    match host_value(host)
        string accepted_host
            normalized_host = accepted_host
        none
            return none
    match path_value(path)
        string accepted_path
            normalized_path = accepted_path
        none
            return none
    result := scheme + "://" + normalized_host
    if has_port
        if not digits(port, 1, 5) or port.starts_with("0")
            return none
        number := int(port)
        if number > 65535
            return none
        if not ((scheme == "http" and number == 80) or (scheme == "https" and number == 443))
            result += ":" + port
    return result + normalized_path

int | none date_value(string text)
    if #text != 10 or text[4] != "-" or text[7] != "-"
        return none
    if not digits(text[0:<4], 4, 4) or not digits(text[5:<7], 2, 2) or not digits(text[8:<10], 2, 2)
        return none
    year := int(text[0:<4])
    month := int(text[5:<7])
    day := int(text[8:<10])
    if year < 1 or not (1 <= month <= 12)
        return none
    days := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    maximum := days[month - 1]
    if month == 2 and ((year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or year % 400 == 0)
        maximum = 29
    if not (1 <= day <= maximum)
        return none
    return year * 10000 + month * 100 + day

Scalar | none scalar_value(string kind, string text, string[] allowed)
    if kind == "string"
        return Scalar(emitter.scalar_notation(kind, text), int(#text))
    if kind == "bool"
        lowered := lowercase(text)
        if lowered == "true" or lowered == "yes" or lowered == "on" or lowered == "1"
            return Scalar(emitter.scalar_notation(kind, text, 0, true), 0, true)
        if lowered == "false" or lowered == "no" or lowered == "off" or lowered == "0"
            return Scalar(emitter.scalar_notation(kind, text))
        return none
    if kind == "enum"
        for candidate := allowed[]
            if lowercase(text) == lowercase(candidate)
                return Scalar(emitter.scalar_notation(kind, candidate))
        return none
    if kind == "int" or kind == "size" or kind == "duration" or kind == "date"
        int | none number := none
        if kind == "int"
            number = integer_value(text)
        elif kind == "size"
            number = size_value(text)
        elif kind == "duration"
            number = duration_value(text)
        else
            number = date_value(text)
        match number
            int value
                return Scalar(emitter.scalar_notation(kind, text, value), value)
            none
                return none
    string | none normalized := none
    if kind == "host"
        normalized = host_value(text)
    elif kind == "path"
        normalized = path_value(text)
    elif kind == "url"
        normalized = url_value(text)
    match normalized
        string value
            return Scalar(emitter.scalar_notation(kind, value))
        none
            return none

class Parent(string section, lexer.Origin origin)

class Profile(string name, string root, nat manifest_line, string[] overrides)
    configuration := map<string, interpolate.Definition>()
    parents := map<string, Parent>()
    outputs := map<string, emitter.Output>()
    nat definition_count := 0
    (nat, string)[] tree := []
    lexer.Diagnostic[] diagnostics := []
    (string, lexer.Origin[])[] overridden := []
    nat errors := 0
    nat warnings := 0
    nat document_keys := 0
    nat manifest_keys := 0
    nat default_keys := 0
    nat dropped := 0

    void .report(lexer.Origin origin, string code, string message)
        diagnostic := lexer.Diagnostic(origin, code, message)
        for previous := diagnostics[]
            if previous == diagnostic
                return
        diagnostics = diagnostics.append(diagnostic)

    void .define(string key, string value, lexer.Origin origin)
        definition_count += 1
        lexer.Origin[] history := []
        match configuration.get(key)
            interpolate.Definition earlier
                history = earlier.history
            none
                history = []
        if #history == 0 or history[-1] != origin
            history = history.append(origin)
        .configuration.set(key, interpolate.Definition(value, origin, definition_count, history))

class Library()
    documents := map<string, ini.Document>()
    missing := distinct<string>()

    ini.Document | none .find(string name)
        match documents.get(name)
            ini.Document cached
                return cached
            none
                if missing.has(name)
                    return none
        path := "input/conf/" + name + ".ini"
        bool present := file.exists(path)
        if not present
            .missing.add(name)
            return none
        parsed := ini.parse_document(name, lexer.read_lines(path))
        .documents.set(name, parsed)
        return parsed

void apply_document(Profile &profile, Library &library, string name, string[] chain)
    ini.Document document
    match .library.find(name)
        ini.Document found
            document = found
        none
            return
    profile.tree = profile.tree.append((#chain - 1, name))
    for diagnostic := document.diagnostics[]
        .profile.report(diagnostic.origin, diagnostic.code, diagnostic.message)
    for statement := document.statements[]
        origin := lexer.Origin(name, statement.line)
        string key := statement.target
        if statement.kind == "assign"
            .profile.define(key, statement.value, origin)
        elif statement.kind == "append"
            string value := statement.value
            match profile.configuration.get(key)
                interpolate.Definition earlier
                    if earlier.value != ""
                        value = earlier.value + "," + value
                none
                    value = statement.value
            .profile.define(key, value, origin)
        elif statement.kind == "unset"
            if not (.profile.configuration.remove(key))
                .profile.report(origin, "W_UNSET", key + " is not set")
        elif statement.kind == "inherit"
            .profile.parents.set(key, Parent(statement.value, origin))
        else
            cycle := false
            for: active := chain[index]
                if active == key
                    path := chain[index:<#chain].append(key)
                    .profile.report(origin, "E_INCLUDE_CYCLE", "include cycle " + path.join(" -> "))
                    profile.tree = profile.tree.append((#chain, key + " (cycle)"))
                    cycle = true
                    break
            if cycle
                continue
            match .library.find(key)
                ini.Document included
                    apply_document(&profile, &library, key, chain.append(key))
                none
                    .profile.report(origin, "E_INCLUDE_MISSING", "missing document " + key)
                    profile.tree = profile.tree.append((#chain, key + " (missing)"))

void inherit_sections(Profile &profile)
    snapshot := profile.configuration
    for section := profile.parents.keys()[]
        Parent declaration := lexer.entry(profile.parents, section)
        chain := [section]
        current := section
        cycle := false
        while profile.parents.has(current)
            Parent parent := lexer.entry(profile.parents, current)
            repeated := false
            for visited := chain[]
                if visited == parent.section
                    repeated = true
            chain = chain.append(parent.section)
            if repeated
                .profile.report(declaration.origin, "E_INHERIT_CYCLE", "inheritance cycle " + chain.join(" -> "))
                cycle = true
                break
            current = parent.section
        if cycle
            continue
        parent_has_keys := false
        for original := snapshot.keys()[]
            if ini.section_of(original) == declaration.section
                parent_has_keys = true
        if not profile.parents.has(declaration.section) and not parent_has_keys
            .profile.report(declaration.origin, "W_PARENT_EMPTY", "section {section} inherits from empty section {declaration.section}")
        for: 1 <= ancestor_index < #chain
            ancestor := chain[ancestor_index]
            for original := snapshot.keys()[]
                if ini.section_of(original) != ancestor
                    continue
                target := section + "." + ini.key_name(original)
                if not profile.configuration.has(target)
                    .profile.configuration.set(target, lexer.entry(snapshot, original))

void resolve_aliases(Profile &profile, schema.Schema rules)
    for spec := rules.specs[]
        if not spec.has("alias")
            continue
        string[] aliases := spec.attribute("alias").split(",")
        string[] candidates := []
        if profile.configuration.has(spec.pattern)
            candidates = candidates.append(spec.pattern)
        nat alias_count := 0
        for alias := aliases[]
            if profile.configuration.has(alias)
                candidates = candidates.append(alias)
                alias_count += 1
        if alias_count == 0
            continue
        winner := candidates[0]
        interpolate.Definition chosen := lexer.entry(profile.configuration, winner)
        for candidate := candidates[]
            interpolate.Definition definition := lexer.entry(profile.configuration, candidate)
            if definition.number > chosen.number
                chosen = definition
                winner = candidate
        for candidate := candidates[]
            interpolate.Definition definition := lexer.entry(profile.configuration, candidate)
            if candidate != spec.pattern
                .profile.report(definition.origin, "W_DEPRECATED", "{candidate} is deprecated, use {spec.pattern}")
            if candidate != winner
                .profile.report(definition.origin, "W_SHADOWED", "{candidate} is superseded by {winner} at {chosen.origin.text()}")
        .profile.configuration.set(spec.pattern, chosen)
        for alias := aliases[]
            .profile.configuration.remove(alias)

string[] fill_defaults(Profile &profile, schema.Schema rules)
    distinct<string> sections
    for key := profile.configuration.keys()[]
        .sections.add(ini.section_of(key))
    instances := sections.values()
    for spec := rules.specs[]
        if spec.has("default")
            for target := rules.targets(spec, instances)[]
                if not profile.configuration.has(target)
                    .profile.define(target, spec.attribute("default"), lexer.Origin("schema", spec.line))
    return instances

void report_invalid(Profile &profile, string key, string kind, string[] allowed,
                    string text, bool secret, bool item, lexer.Origin origin)
    display := if secret then "********" else emitter.string_notation(text)
    if item
        display = "item " + display
    if kind == "enum"
        .profile.report(origin, "E_ENUM", key + ": " + display + " is not one of " + allowed.join(","))
    else
        .profile.report(origin, "E_TYPE", key + ": " + display + " is not a valid " + kind)

Scalar | none normalize(Profile &profile, string key, schema.Spec spec,
                        string text, lexer.Origin origin)
    secret := spec.has("secret")
    string[] allowed := if spec.has("values") then spec.attribute("values").split(",") else []
    Scalar normalized
    if spec.kind == "list"
        item_kind := spec.attribute("item", "string")
        string[] items := []
        if lexer.trim_spaces(text) != ""
            for raw := text.split(",")[]
                item := lexer.trim_spaces(raw)
                if item == ""
                    .profile.report(origin, "W_EMPTY_ITEM", key + ": empty list item ignored")
                else
                    items = items.append(item)
        string[] notations := []
        for item := items[]
            match scalar_value(item_kind, item, allowed)
                Scalar accepted
                    notations = notations.append(accepted.notation)
                none
                    report_invalid(&profile, key, item_kind, allowed, item, secret, true, origin)
                    return none
        if spec.has("unique")
            distinct<string> seen
            string[] unique_notations := []
            for notation := notations[]
                if not seen.has(notation)
                    .seen.add(notation)
                    unique_notations = unique_notations.append(notation)
            if #unique_notations < #notations
                .profile.report(origin, "W_DUPLICATE_ITEM", key + ": duplicate items removed")
            notations = unique_notations
        normalized = Scalar(emitter.list_notation(notations), int(#notations))
    else
        match scalar_value(spec.kind, text, allowed)
            Scalar accepted
                normalized = accepted
            none
                report_invalid(&profile, key, spec.kind, allowed, text, secret, false, origin)
                return none
    if spec.has("range")
        bounds := spec.attribute("range").split("..")
        string[] displayed_bounds := []
        outside := false
        for: bound := bounds[index]
            if bound == ""
                displayed_bounds = displayed_bounds.append("")
                continue
            measure := 0
            notation := ""
            if spec.kind == "string" or spec.kind == "list"
                measure = int(bound)
                notation = string(measure)
            else
                match scalar_value(spec.kind, bound, [])
                    Scalar valid_bound
                        measure = valid_bound.measure
                        notation = valid_bound.notation
                    none
                        return none
            displayed_bounds = displayed_bounds.append(notation)
            if (index == 0 and normalized.measure < measure) or (index == 1 and normalized.measure > measure)
                outside = true
        if outside
            display := if secret then "********" else normalized.notation
            if spec.kind == "string"
                display = "length {normalized.measure}"
            elif spec.kind == "list"
                display = "count {normalized.measure}"
            .profile.report(origin, "E_RANGE", key + ": " + display + " is out of range " + displayed_bounds.join(".."))
            return none
    return normalized

void check_types(Profile &profile, schema.Schema rules)
    expander := interpolate.Expander(profile.configuration)
    for key := ini.ordered_keys(profile.configuration.keys())[]
        .expander.expand(key)
    for diagnostic := expander.diagnostics[]
        .profile.report(diagnostic.origin, diagnostic.code, diagnostic.message)
    for key := ini.ordered_keys(expander.results.keys())[]
        string text := lexer.entry(expander.results, key)
        interpolate.Definition definition := lexer.entry(profile.configuration, key)
        match rules.spec_for(key)
            schema.Spec spec
                match normalize(&profile, key, spec, text, definition.origin)
                    Scalar value
                        .profile.outputs.set(key, emitter.Output(definition, spec.kind, spec.has("secret"),
                            value.notation, value.measure, value.truth, spec.has("fixed"), spec.attribute("le")))
                    none
                        continue
            none
                .profile.report(definition.origin, "W_UNKNOWN", key + " is not in the schema")
                .profile.outputs.set(key, emitter.Output(definition, "string", false,
                    emitter.string_notation(text), int(#text), false, false, ""))

void check_order(Profile &profile)
    string[] removed := []
    for key := ini.ordered_keys(profile.outputs.keys())[]
        emitter.Output output := lexer.entry(profile.outputs, key)
        if output.limit == ""
            continue
        other_key := ini.section_of(key) + "." + output.limit
        match profile.outputs.get(other_key)
            emitter.Output limit
                if output.measure > limit.measure
                    .profile.report(output.definition.origin, "E_ORDER", key + ": " + emitter.shown(output)
                        + " is greater than " + other_key + " (" + emitter.shown(limit) + ")")
                    removed = removed.append(key)
            none
                continue
    for key := removed[]
        .profile.outputs.remove(key)

void check_required(Profile &profile, schema.Schema rules, string[] instances,
                    const map<string, interpolate.Definition> configured)
    for spec := rules.specs[]
        if not spec.has("required")
            continue
        for target := rules.targets(spec, instances)[]
            if configured.has(target)
                continue
            origin := lexer.Origin(profile.root, 0)
            if not spec.has("when")
                .profile.report(origin, "E_REQUIRED", target + " is required")
            else
                string condition := ini.section_of(target) + "." + spec.attribute("when")
                match profile.outputs.get(condition)
                    emitter.Output output
                        if output.kind == "bool" and output.truth
                            .profile.report(origin, "E_REQUIRED", "{target} is required when {condition} is true")
                    none
                        continue

void check_fixed(Profile &profile, const Profile[] earlier)
    for key := ini.ordered_keys(profile.outputs.keys())[]
        emitter.Output output := lexer.entry(profile.outputs, key)
        if not output.fixed
            continue
        for previous := earlier[]
            match previous.outputs.get(key)
                emitter.Output reference
                    if output.notation != reference.notation
                        .profile.report(output.definition.origin, "E_FIXED", "{key}: value differs from profile {previous.name}")
                        .profile.outputs.remove(key)
                    break
                none
                    continue

bool diagnostic_before(lexer.Diagnostic left, lexer.Diagnostic right)
    if left.origin.document != right.origin.document
        return lexer.before(left.origin.document, right.origin.document)
    if left.origin.line != right.origin.line
        return left.origin.line < right.origin.line
    if left.code != right.code
        return lexer.before(left.code, right.code)
    return lexer.before(left.message, right.message)

void summarize(Profile &profile, nat configured_count)
    lexer.Diagnostic[] ordered := []
    for diagnostic := profile.diagnostics[]
        nat position := 0
        while position < #ordered and not diagnostic_before(diagnostic, ordered[position])
            position += 1
        ordered = ordered[0:<position].append(diagnostic).concat(ordered[position:<#ordered])
    profile.diagnostics = ordered
    for diagnostic := ordered[]
        if diagnostic.code.starts_with("E_")
            profile.errors += 1
        else
            profile.warnings += 1
    for key := ini.ordered_keys(profile.outputs.keys())[]
        emitter.Output output := lexer.entry(profile.outputs, key)
        if #output.definition.history >= 2
            profile.overridden = profile.overridden.append((key, output.definition.history))
        if output.definition.origin.document == "manifest"
            profile.manifest_keys += 1
        elif output.definition.origin.document == "schema"
            profile.default_keys += 1
        else
            profile.document_keys += 1
    profile.dropped = configured_count - profile.outputs.size()

void process_profile(Profile &profile, Library &library, schema.Schema rules, const Profile[] earlier)
    apply_document(&profile, &library, profile.root, [profile.root])
    for override := profile.overrides[]
        match override.find("=")
            nat equals
                .profile.define(override[0:<equals], override[equals + 1:<#override],
                    lexer.Origin("manifest", profile.manifest_line))
            none
                continue
    inherit_sections(&profile)
    resolve_aliases(&profile, rules)
    instances := fill_defaults(&profile, rules)
    configured := profile.configuration
    check_types(&profile, rules)
    check_order(&profile)
    check_required(&profile, rules, instances, configured)
    check_fixed(&profile, earlier)
    summarize(&profile, configured.size())

emitter.Diff difference(Profile first, Profile second)
    result := emitter.Diff(first.name, second.name)
    distinct<string> keys
    for key := first.outputs.keys().concat(second.outputs.keys())[]
        .keys.add(key)
    for key := ini.ordered_keys(keys.values())[]
        if not first.outputs.has(key)
            emitter.Output after := lexer.entry(second.outputs, key)
            result.added += 1
            result.entries = result.entries.append(emitter.DiffEntry("+", key, "", emitter.shown(after)))
        elif not second.outputs.has(key)
            emitter.Output before := lexer.entry(first.outputs, key)
            result.removed += 1
            result.entries = result.entries.append(emitter.DiffEntry("-", key, emitter.shown(before), ""))
        else
            emitter.Output before := lexer.entry(first.outputs, key)
            emitter.Output after := lexer.entry(second.outputs, key)
            if before.notation != after.notation
                result.changed += 1
                result.entries = result.entries.append(emitter.DiffEntry("~", key, emitter.shown(before), emitter.shown(after)))
    return result

if main
    rules := schema.read_schema("input/schema.txt")
    library := Library()
    Profile[] profiles := []
    emitter.Diff[] differences := []
    manifest := lexer.read_lines("input/manifest.txt")
    for: line := manifest[index]
        words := line.split(" ")
        profile := Profile(words[0], words[1], index + 1, words[2:<#words])
        process_profile(&profile, &library, rules, profiles)
        if #profiles > 0
            differences = differences.append(difference(profiles[-1], profile))
        profiles = profiles.append(profile)
    emitter.write_outputs(profiles, differences)

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import ini = "./ini_parser.qui"

class Spec(nat line, string pattern, string kind)
    string[] section_parts := ini.section_of(pattern).split(".")
    string key := ini.key_name(pattern)
    bool wildcard := ini.section_of(pattern).contains("*")
    flags := distinct<string>()
    attributes := map<string, string>()

    bool has(string sought)
        return flags.has(sought) or attributes.has(sought)

    string attribute(string name, fallback := "")
        match attributes.get(name)
            string value
                return value
            none
                return fallback

    bool matches(string section)
        parts := section.split(".")
        if #parts != #section_parts
            return false
        for: index < #parts
            if section_parts[index] != "*" and section_parts[index] != parts[index]
                return false
        return true

class Schema(Spec[] specs)
    Spec | none spec_for(string full_key)
        for exact := specs[]
            if not exact.wildcard and exact.pattern == full_key
                return exact
        section := ini.section_of(full_key)
        name := ini.key_name(full_key)
        for candidate := specs[]
            if candidate.wildcard and candidate.key == name and candidate.matches(section)
                return candidate
        return none

    string[] targets(Spec chosen, string[] sections)
        if not chosen.wildcard
            return [chosen.pattern]
        string[] result := []
        for section := sections.sorted()[]
            if not chosen.matches(section)
                continue
            key := section + "." + chosen.key
            match spec_for(key)
                Spec actual
                    if actual.line == chosen.line
                        result = result.append(key)
                none
                    continue
        return result

Schema read_schema(string path)
    Spec[] specs := []
    lines := lexer.read_lines(path)
    for: line := lines[index]
        if lexer.trim_spaces(line) == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        spec := Spec(index + 1, words[0], words[1])
        for: 2 <= attribute_index < #words
            word := words[attribute_index]
            match word.find("=")
                nat equals
                    .spec.attributes.set(word[0:<equals], word[equals + 1:<#word])
                none
                    .spec.flags.add(word)
        specs = specs.append(spec)
    return Schema(specs)
